name: (ADFS) File Access Control
description: Signed download URLs with expiry (HMAC-SHA256), per-file download-count limiting, per-file and global IP allowlist/blocklist, and a per-download access log. Sub-module of Advanced Filesystem.
project_description: The File Access Control sub-module of Advanced Filesystem adds a signed-download layer on top of Drupal's file entities. A FileAccessService generates root-relative capability URLs of the form /adfs/download/{fid}/{token}?expires={timestamp}, where the token is an HMAC-SHA256 of "fid={fid}&expires={expires}" computed with an admin-configured signing secret; the SecureDownloadController validates the token with hash_equals, checks per-file and global IP allow/block lists, enforces a per-file download-count limit, writes an access-log row, then streams the file as an attachment with no-cache headers. A Twig filter and function (adfs_signed_url) let themes emit signed links from a file entity, a FID or a field item, with TTL shorthands like '1h', '24h' or '7d'. Per-file rules (download limit, access expiry, IP allow/block lists) are edited on an 'Access Rules' local task at /admin/content/files/{fid}/access-rules; global settings (signing secret, default TTL, global IP blocklist, log retention) live at admin/config/media/advanced_filesystem/access. Two custom tables (adfs_access_log, adfs_access_config) back the feature, and a hook_file_access() implementation also enforces the download-count limit on ordinary file downloads. All administration is gated behind the restricted 'administer advanced_filesystem_access' permission.
